info.title: v2.order.search_package_list
info.description: Use this API to search the list of packages that have not been SHIPPED to proceed arranging shipment, and it supports various filters and sort fields.

post.description: Use this API to search the list of packages that have not been SHIPPED to proceed arranging shipment, and it supports various filters and sort fields.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Use this field to specify whether the returned package list is sorted in ascending or descending sort_type. Default value = true

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is "". If data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: fulfillment_type
parameters.description: Use this field to filter the packages fulfilled by shopee or seller. Applicable values: 0: None (not apply filter) 1: Shopee 2: Seller Default value = 2 (Seller)

parameters.name: invoice_pending
parameters.description: Use this field to filter the packages under invoice_pending. Default value = false

parameters.name: is_pre_order
parameters.description: Use this field to filter packages by pre-order status. Applicable values: 0: All 1: Pre-Order 2: Non Pre-Order Default value = 0 (All)

parameters.name: logistics_channel_ids
parameters.description: List of logistics_channel_id. Use this field to filter the packages under specific logistics channels.

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: Use this field to filter packages by order type. Applicable values: 0: All 1: Regular Order 2: Instant Order Default value = 0 (All) Note: For VN shops, using 2: Instant Order will return both Instant Delivery and Same-day Delivery packages.

parameters.name: package_status
parameters.description: Use this field to filter the packages of specific status. Applicable values: 0: All 1: Pending 2: ToProcess 3: Processed Default value = 2 (ToProcess)

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data.The limit of page_size if between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: product_location_ids
parameters.description: List of product_location_id. Use this field to filter the packages under specific warehouses.

parameters.name: shipping_priority
parameters.description: Use this field to filter packages by shipping priority. Applicable values: - For MY/PH/TW/TH shops, and VN Preferred/Preferred Plus/Shopee Mall shops: 0: All 1: Overdue 2: Ship by Today 3: Ship by Tomorrow - For other shops： 0: All 1: Overdue 2: Within 24h 3: Beyond 24h Default value = 0 (All)

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: sort_type
parameters.description: Use this field to specify which field to use to sort the returned package list. Available values: 1: ShipByDate 2: CreateDate 3: ConfirmedDate Default value = 1 (ShipByDate)

parameters.name: sorting_group
parameters.description: [Only for TW 30029 channel] Use this field to filter the sorting group of parcel. This field is only available for package with package_status = 3 and logistics_channel_id = 30029. Applicable values: 0: All 1: North 2: South

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/search_package_list?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "filter": {
        "fulfillment_type": 2,
        "invoice_pending": false,
        "is_pre_order": 0,
        "logistics_channel_ids": [
            50021
        ],
        "order_type": 0,
        "package_status": 2,
        "product_location_ids": [
            "VN0005EIZ"
        ],
        "shipping_priority": 0,
        "sorting_group": 1
    },
    "pagination": {
        "cursor": "\\"\\"",
        "page_size": 5
    },
    "sort": {
        "ascending": false,
        "sort_type": 1
    }
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Just use this field to pass the next step of Mass ArrangeShipment

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: sorting_group
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [Only for TW 30029 channel] This field indicate the sorting group value of the package. This field is only available for logistics_channel_id = 30029 and after the package has been arranged for shipment.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_shipment_arranged
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Only effective when the package's logistics_status/fulfillment_status is LOGISTICS_READY. This parameter further distinguishes between two scenarios: - true: Package shipment has been arranged (Seller has processed shipment, system is generating tracking number, not yet updated to LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED, no duplicate action needed) - false: Package awaiting shipment arrangement (Seller hasn't processed shipment yet, shipping arrangement required)

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: total_count
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Total orders can be returned with your query

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: next_cursor
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: if packages is not empty or length of packages <= page_size. You should pass the next_cursor in the next request as page_sentinel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate, it's a the last page or not

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: request_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The identifier for an API request for error tracking.
